styleContract.lighting: soft stadium key plus cool rim
styleContract.scaleRule: Normalize standing height to the shared Gamecast character box while preserving player-specific build differences.
styleContract.uniform: Dallas white/silver/royal-blue; current jersey number required; no invented accessories.
styleContract.appearanceRule: Render complexion, hair, facial hair and visible facial traits only after visual inspection of the cited current official Dallas headshot. Never infer appearance from name.
styleContract.reuseRule: Base mesh/material rig is the authoritative neutral player asset from which action poses and animation clips are derived; do not redraw identity between actions.
